content: बिन्दुः [बिन्द्-उ] A drop, small particle; जलबिन्दुनिपातेन क्रमशः पूर्यते घटः ‘small drops make a pool’; विस्तीर्यते यशो लोके तैलबिन्दुरिवाम्भसि <ls>Ms. 7. 33</ls>; संक्षिप्यते यशो लोके घृतबिन्दुरिवाम्भसि <ls n="Ms.">7. 34</ls>; अधुना (कुतूहलस्य) बिन्दुरपि नावशेषितः <ls>Ś. 2</ls>. .²2 A dot, point. .²3 A spot or mark of coloured paint on the body of an elephant; न्यस्ताक्षरा धातुरसेन यत्र भूर्जत्वचः कुञ्जरबिन्दुशोणाः <ls>Ku. 1. 7</ls>. .²4 A zero or cypher; न रोमकूपौघमिषाज्जगत्कृता कृताश्च किं दूषणशून्यबिन्दवः <ls>N. 1. 21</ls>. .²5 (In <ab>geom.</ab>) A point having no parts or no magnitude. .²6 A drop of water taken as a measure. .²7 The dot over a letter representing the अनुस्वार. .²8 (In manuscripts) A mark over an erased word (which shows that the word ought not to be erased); ‘stet’. .²9 A mark made by the teeth of a lover on the lips of his mistress. .²10 A peculiar mark like a dot made in cauterizing. .²11 The part of the forehead between the eyebrows. .²12 (In dramas) The sudden development of a secondary incident (which, like a drop of oil in water quickly diffuses itself and thus supplies important elements in the development of the plot; it is the source of an intermediate object, while ‘Bīja’ is that of the principal one); अवान्तरार्थविच्छेदे बिन्दुरुच्छेदकारणम् <ls>S. D. 319</ls>. .²13 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) A condition of चिच्छक्ति; सच्चिदानन्दविभवात् सकलात् परमेश्वरात् . आसीच्छक्तिस्ततो नादो नादाद् बिन्दुसमुद्भवः ..
